title: Pompeii Wardrobe Opens After Almost 2,000 Years
paragraphs: Pompeii is an ancient Roman city in Italy. In the year 79, the volcano Vesuvius covered it with ash. Experts still find new things there today.
In October 2026, the Archaeological Park of Pompeii shared a new discovery. In a house on a busy street, experts found a wooden cupboard. It had stayed closed for almost 2,000 years.

Inside the cupboard, they found a necklace with at least 24 small charms, 38 bronze coins, a perfume bottle and some cooking pots. The director said ordinary objects like these show how normal people lived. Experts do not know who lived in the house. The family may have left in a hurry and never come back.

questions.a: A necklace, bronze coins, a perfume bottle and cooking pots.

questions.q: Do experts know who lived in the house?
questions.a: No, they cannot say for sure.
